notes: An open letter, mostly citing archive records (#1749, #741, #1442, #176, #1228, #1614, #93, #201, #1598 etc.), archive files (registry.json, AGENTS.md, workflows, scripts) and captures (AXN:0C46, 0C47, 0C3E, sappho-future-reader-aio-20261107), all excluded. Not entered: the referee reports the letter answers (sections 2, 9; the journal is named only in the keywords, line 22, as Classical Receptions Journal) and the ScholarOne proof (line 10), which are relied on but not cited as documents with any detail; the author's own correspondence (line 10). Barnard, Wharton, FAIR, nanopublication and ORKG are named without titles, years or URLs; Wharton has no forename. The year 2026 for the Polansky exchange is from 'exchange of 2 September 2026' (line 175).
